handoff.objective: Natural anchored divisors and sparse signed stitching
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Implement a general signed outside-incidence reduction with exact cancellation/rank checks and an all-draw anchored panel.
constraints: PHASE A ONLY: literature-first review, source/analysis/export engineering and complete protocol.draft.json. No second-pass experiment rows, pilot arithmetic panels, sweeps or benchmark data until explicit root Phase B release.

Phase B requires committed+pushed source/input/analysis hashes, validated frozen experiment.protocol/v1 before first affected data, complete .resume/RESUME.md, real successful scripts/checkpoint.sh push and gate, and root release bound to exact bytes. Pending user input or failed/denied S3 push never authorizes launch.

Use actual published fields and exact curve/subgroup identities. Old study files remain immutable. No official research-state transition, novelty, comparative speed, end-to-end ECDLP advantage or formal/canonical review certification.
Write only assigned tracks/fN/**. No Git mutations, official ledger writes, external messages, extra agents or model swaps. Root owns shared publication and archival work.
Every attempt gets fresh output paths; preserve all failures, rejected draws and unknowns. No retry until green. A watchdog is infrastructure status, never a mathematical negative.
Native inherited Codex model is unprobed; do not claim model_verified or canonical model-policy admission. No Bedrock runtime/probe.

All reported quantities trace to raw output; count metrics exact, clock diagnostics wall_valid=false on the shared host. Retain native counters and excluded work. No statistical/general-yield inference from tiny finite domains.

Follow docs/experiment-protocol.md, tools/experiment_protocol.py and the materialized canonical run/experiment-protocol/research-visuals skills. Draft validates before root freezes; any later change is prospective amended version.
New report.md/result.json plus editable SVG/source and fresh inspected compact report PDF for each track; root may render. Never reuse a historical PDF as current.
implementation_steps: Freeze128 line functions A(x)+y: eight deterministic base anchors with16 hash-derived slopes per anchor. Factor every norm and retain nonrational factors, unusable draws and exact sampling law. Admit a two-outside-point graph edge only when the complete principal divisor is certified.

Implement sparse signed elimination, balanced/unbalanced cycles and combinations of two unbalanced cycles. Output exact integer cancellation coefficients and rank modulo r; compare with a separate dense incidence nullspace.
controls: Known constructed graphs are controls separate from natural collision data.
A lone unbalanced triangle must not cancel; omitted nonrational factors and flipped signs must fail.
deliverables: run.py --out <fresh-directory> --seed <integer>; import and --help never execute a panel.
protocol.draft.json under experiment.protocol/v1; per-track analysis.py and exporter source frozen before affected data.
literature.md with actual primary/internal sources read, exact assumptions, transfer limits and access gaps.
After Phase B only: raw case records, commands/host/resource identities, rows.jsonl, experiment.export/v1 export.json and flow.
result.json/report.md/diagram.svg/editable source plus complete new report/PDF source and unresolved interface.

inference.runtime: native inherited Codex model; binding unprobed; canonical admission not claimed

phase_A: Literature notes and complete source/draft/analysis/export preparation exist without experiment outputs.
Draft protocol validates; source is ready for root commit/pinning/freeze.
phase_B: Root release names the successful real S3 checkpoint/gate and frozen exact source/protocol.
Every fixed case has completed or explicit unknown/not_completed status and independent correctness controls.

handoff.remaining_obligation: Anchored sampling is conditional, not uniform sections; no observed collisions gives no general yield or impossibility theorem.
handoff.return_format: Phase A paths, exact commands and missing gates now; after Phase B release, raw/export/report paths, scoped observations and unknowns.
